plain: To cut costs; to reduce spending

webster.text: To cut off; to pare away.

example.quote: I fear their payment may press on my country ; but we must retrench our superfluities, and profuse and idle extravagance, and become more economical and industrious.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
